milestone: Anonymous statement suites with immutable local bindings and final expressions
scope: Lambda AST stores ordered statement suites with source spans and child-before-parent expression IDs
Indented anonymous bodies, compact expression compatibility, immutable local bindings and expected/result annotations
Parameter rebinding and duplicate local rejection; initializer-before-shadowing, lexical scope and nested local captures
Existing if/else, exhaustive matches, catch, early fail guards and try propagation under expected callable channels
Pending expected-result obligations checked in general and direct-map callback suites
Higher-order calls, pipelines, bound block callbacks, empty maps and imported helper-module name resolution
All ten CPU numeric scalar widths and managed array/String/record body values
Worker-local creation/invocation, owned worker results, cached awaits and coordinator-held callbacks across suspension
Source-preserving arithmetic faults, failed/stopped context checks, untouched failed creation output and allocation-failure settlement
Parser diagnostics P007/P035, nesting/node budgets, CRLF/EOF termination and dedented following-call boundaries
Relevant existing parser, semantic, function-value, collection, closure, map, module, control-flow, application-error and worker-error regressions

ctest.selection: New block suites run in debug, optimized, ASan/UBSan and separate ThreadSanitizer modes. Existing relevant regression suites run in debug and ASan/UBSan; this is not a repeat of the full prior milestone selection.

additional_checks: Statement ordering, binding annotations, spans and final result
Dedented calls do not attach to a closure body
P007 and P035 diagnostics remain distinct
CRLF input without a final source newline
Direct-map callback AST cannot discard a pending expected error

notes: Implementation and test source hashes were frozen before the selected regression batch
No new runtime representation or scheduler behavior: this extends parsing and typed suites over the existing managed code/environment pair
The runtime probes reuse existing private closure/context harnesses with block-bodied creator/target fixtures
Successful CLI allocation probes must print 42; faulted probes must publish no stdout and report balanced settlement
Current delimiter lexing suppresses indentation inside open call/collection delimiters; bind an indented callback before passing it
not_qualified: Function-valued aggregate storage, indirect spawn, worker function transport and resumable callables
Recursive control-flow callable references, direct static-map control-flow lowering and implicit fallible-map aggregation
Earlier environment reclamation, allocation/copy elimination or performance improvements
A public native callback ABI, distributed execution, CUDA or other platforms
